title: Contract Reconciliation Workflow for Cross-Team Pricing & Legal Acceptance
creator: Jordan Patel
description: Problem: Sales and Legal are repeatedly re-negotiating the same MSA/DPA redlines during high-touch enterprise deals. This creates friction, delays revenue, and causes inconsistent pricing/indemnity decisions across deals. Current channel: sales submits redlines via email or drive links; legal triages manually and routes to Pricing for indemnity/SLA impacts. Goal: design and deliver a contract reconciliation workflow that (1) automatically ingests customer redlines, (2) aligns proposed deviations to an internal playbook and risk tiers, (3) produces a reconciled decision packet for Sales (including suggested counterproposal language, pricing impact estimate, and a routing recommendation), and (4) surfaces a structured acceptance decision back into our contract intake system so Legal can finalize and sign-off faster. Scope: ingestion pipeline for MSA/DPA redlines (PDF/Word), clause-level mapping to our standard playbook, risk-scoring algorithm (indemnity/liability/SLA impact), Sales-facing UI with suggested counterproposal and estimated price adjustment, Legal review checklist with pre-approved thresholds, telemetry for time-to-accept and win-rate. Out of scope: full automation of negotiating novel contractual terms that require C-level approval; change to billing systems. Approach: iterative pilot with top-10 enterprise accounts over 6 weeks. Build an ingestion microservice (document parsing + clause extraction), clause classifier tied to playbook entries, scoring rules authored by Legal + Pricing, and a lightweight Sales review UI integrated into the contract intake form. We'll run the pilot with a Legal reviewer in the loop for all automated recommendations and adjust thresholds. Success metrics: reduce median contract negotiation cycle by 30%, increase auto-approve rate for low-risk redlines to >40%, and shorten Legal review time per contract by 50%.
acceptance_criteria: Automated ingestion: system can accept PDF/DOCX redline documents and extract clause-level diffs with >=85% accuracy in clause boundary detection
Clause mapping: extracted clauses are mapped to a playbook entry or flagged as ‘novel’ with correct mapping >=80% in pilot dataset
Risk scoring: indemnity/liability/SLA impact score produced and documented for each redline; Legal agrees scoring aligns with policy in 90% of pilot reviews
Sales packet: generated reconciled packet contains suggested counterlanguage, a pricing impact estimate (range), and a recommended routing (auto-approve / pricing-review / Legal escalation)
Sales UI: Sales can accept, edit, or request escalation from the packet; choice is logged to the contract intake system
Telemetry: dashboard shows time from intake->packet generation, packet->legal-decision, and final signoff; baseline and pilot comparisons available
Pilot safety: every recommendation in pilot is reviewed and confirmed by a Legal reviewer before being sent to counterparty
Integration: decisions and final disposition are persisted as structured metadata on the contract intake record and exportable to Salesforce as a single-line disposition
